proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal on Lobbying Report
proposals.proponent: Zevin Asset Management, on behalf of William Creighton, and co-filer UAW Retiree Medical Benefits Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing AbbVie's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association model-legislation memberships, and oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal.

proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal to Separate Chair and CEO
proposals.proponent: Congregation of Sisters of St. Agnes
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy, phased in at the next CEO transition, requiring the Board Chair to be an independent director whenever possible.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that stockholders vote AGAINST this proposal.
